\section*{Market model}
The transition matrix links this year's shares to next year's:
\[ M = \begin{pmatrix} 0.8 & 0.1 & 0.1 \\ 0.2 & 0.7 & 0.1 \\ 0.1 & 0.2 & 0.7 \end{pmatrix} \]
and its determinant is
\[ \det B = \begin{vmatrix} a & b & c \\ d & e & f \\ g & h & i \end{vmatrix} . \]
Both segments grow next year.
